     ◆ Thought for 40.2s                                                                                                                             █
                                                                                                                                                     █
     You name a session the way a sailor names a boat he means to leave. Detach, and the work continues without asking where you went.     5:10 PM   █
     The shell keeps its breath in a socket under /tmp. Attach from a kitchen table and the cursor is still mid-word. Screen learned                 █
     this first, stubborn and lowercase. Tmux came later and taught the glass a cleaner break. A prefix is the knock you give before you             █
     move the walls. Split horizontal, and a horizon falls through the middle of the command. Split vertical, and two logs stand side by             █
     side like neighbors who share a wall. Zoom is the mercy of one pane until the test run ends. Windows are floors. Panes are rooms.               █
     Sessions are the building. The status bar keeps a thin biography along the bottom of the afternoon. Copy mode turns scrollback into             █
     a dim library. You search upward for the line you promised you would not lose. A pane can exit. The others hold their geometry.                 █
     Respawn, and the same command comes back in the same shoes. Synchronize-panes makes every shell repeat your typo together. You drag             █
     the borders until the compiler fits beside the watcher. The mouse may take a border if the config allows it. The keys stay faster,              █
     and they still work when the trackpad sleeps. Nest one multiplexer inside another and you inherit two doorbells. Send the outer                 █
     prefix inward, and the inner session finally answers. Spare sockets wait on the server like keys on a nail. Kill the server and                 █
     every light in the building goes out together. A plugin string can bring yesterday's panes back after a crash. Resurrect treats a               █
     reboot as a long blink with the furniture still placed. On the remote host the session outlives the laptop that opened it. Close                █
     the lid at the gate. The build keeps walking the remote disk. Land, attach, and the progress line has moved while you were in the               █
     air. A shared session is a kitchen with two hands on one knife. Read-only attach lets you watch the stove without turning a dial. A             █
     bell from another window is a knock you can leave unanswered. The activity flag colors a pane when output finally arrives. Rename               █
     the window. Otherwise it stays bash, a door with no number. Your config is a dialect of prefixes, colors, and private habits. Start             █
     the indexes at one. The left pane should not have to be zero. Set escape-time too high and vim hesitates on the way out of insert.              █
     The hands learn it: prefix, arrow, prefix, z, prefix, d, stand, go. Rectangles lease your attention and hand it back in one piece.              █
     Leave the session up. In the morning the prompt will still be warm.                                                                             █
